name: Eresidae

facts.text: Eresidae: level 48, a large creature (model 117, size 126), at about 425,900/291,000 high on a ridge north of Dun Crauchon; respawn 300 seconds; a plain spawn.
Strange Powers (a Midgard quest from Mularn): 'Seek out Eresidae on a ridge southeast of Dun Crauchon in Emain Macha' and 'Hand Garon Eresidae's carcass'.

story:
On the highest ridge north of Dun Crauchon lives a creature the rangers of the keep call Eresidae, and it is the only thing in Emain Macha that the men of Midgard cross the frontier on purpose to kill. They come in small bands, young ones, up the far side of the ridge, and take its carcass back over the border, and the rangers of Crauchon have watched it happen for years without ever learning why.

Gormán of the wall, who counts everything, has a theory. He says Midgard's rune-masters need something in the creature's body for a working of theirs, and that a realm that will cross a frontier for a carcass is a realm that has run out of its own. The other rangers say that is a ranger's theory and they would rather the Midgard young kept to the ridge than came to the keep. Eresidae, for its part, does not seem to know whose country it is in.
legend: Eresidae (48) lives on a high ridge north of Dun Crauchon in Emain Macha (about 426k/291k). It is the target of Strange Powers, a Midgard quest, so you will see Midgard lowbies coming for it. For Hibernians it is just a big 48 with a 5-minute respawn. Emain Macha is the enemy realms' way in, so mind warbands from the Midgard portal keep to the east.
